caption: A five-by-five risk matrix: likelihood L from 1 to 5 times impact I from 1 to 5 gives scores 1 to 25. The top-right cell, score 25, is the highest risk; the cell below it is 20.

spec.title: 5 by 5 risk matrix
spec.aria: A five-by-five risk matrix multiplies likelihood from 1 to 5 by impact from 1 to 5, giving risk scores from 1 to 25.
